message.content: {"caption":"A workflow diagram showing how verified training sandboxes, rubric checks, and synthesized environments are assembled and verified.","description":"The diagram has three numbered sections. (1) “VERA Training Data Workflow”: a green-checked “Verified Environments” box, “Task Queries” (question-mark icon), and “History Context” (history/clock icon) are joined by plus signs and feed right via a blue arrow into “Training Sandboxes,” marked with a Docker icon. Text beside it reads “x 4,567 CoWork” and “x 4,864 Med.” (2) “Automated Rubric Generation & Solid Agent Judge”: the green-outlined “Auto Rubrics” panel has three entries—Skill (skill config & criteria), Tool (tool config & API docs), and Trajectory (agent config & exe. logs). Each entry has a “sub-rubrics” mini-list showing {0, 1} twice and an ellipsis. The adjacent “Agent Judge” panel has six checks in a two-column grid: Skill—“code,” correct skill schema; Tool—“code,” correct tool schema; Args—green “judge” tag, parameters valid; Effect—green “judge” tag, action state verified; Artifacts—green “judge” tag, evidence claims; and Context—green “judge” tag, output quality check. (3) “Environment Synthesis”: “Benchmark Trajectories” contains CoWork / terminal-bench / SWE-bench and Med / AutoMedBench / MedXpertQA, with an “agent trajectories” row below. A green arrow leads right from that row to a panel containing “Auto Rubrics,” “Agent Judge,” and “+ Coding Agent”; a downward outlined arrow leads from the coding-agent area to the sequence “S1. plan – S2. setup – S3. verify – S4. execute – S5. submit.” A green arrow also descends from the benchmark trajectories toward a lower pale-green environment area, while another descends from the stage sequence into its Stage-Wise environment. The lower area shows “+” and a robot icon beside “LLM Surrogate,” and contains an “End-to-End Env.” box labeled “end-to-end (excl. heavy execution)” with the number 80, plus a Stage-Wise Env. table with S1 70, S2 81, S3 65, S4 90, and S5 75. In the center, a question-mark icon labeled “Queries” has arrows pointing outward toward the end-to-end and stage-wise environments. Along the bottom, green arrows from both environments point inward to a green check and “verify by Agent Judge.”","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
